deck_title: Chladni-Kirchhoff omega = sqrt(D/rho*h)*k^2 biharmonic plate modal dispersion law vs naive linear-k membrane rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Ernst Chladni (1787) & Gustav Kirchhoff (1850) flexural plate 4th-order biharmonic modal dispersion law (solving rho*h*w_tt + D*nabla^4(w) = 0 so resonant angular frequency scales quadratically with wavenumber as omega_Chladni = sqrt(D / (rho*h)) * k^2 = omega_0 * (1 + u)^2, locking omega_exact / omega_model = 1.0000x across all 17 wavenumber stations u = k/k_0 - 1 in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive 2nd-order membrane wave equation shader (omega = omega_0*(k/k_0) = omega_0*(1 + u), which underestimates Chladni plate frequency by k/k_0 = 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stations) and 64-slice biharmonic bending-energy Rayleigh quotient quadrature.
